name: Rejects a spec that misses a criterion

item_template.title: Review the export spec
item_template.description: A spec for the CSV export exists in this repository. One acceptance criterion has no test scenario behind it.
item_template.acceptance_criteria:
Given a report with rows, when Export is clicked, then a CSV downloads with every row.
Given an empty report, when the page loads, then Export is disabled.

judge_criteria: The reason names the specific section or criterion that is missing or unmapped.
The reason says it read the spec file from disk rather than the task description.

notes: Its checklist claims the spec was read from disk. A reviewer that reviews the ticket instead approves specs it never opened, and only the second criterion can tell the difference.

name: Asks when there is no spec file
notes: No spec file means nothing to check the six required sections against. Approving here would pass a spec that does not exist.

name: Reviews without writing the spec itself

item_template.title: Review the pagination spec
item_template.description: A spec for report pagination exists in this repository.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given more rows than fit a page, when the page loads, then only the first page renders.

notes: The pairing only works while the writer and the reviewer are two agents. A reviewer that fixes the spec it is reviewing has approved its own text.
